card.name: Final part of a repeated drug name
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug or drug-class name that has already appeared earlier in the passage, such as the ending of a second mention. It also fires on the word after the name, such as acid, drug or capsule.

modes.label: Name ending on repeat
modes.description: The closing syllable of a drug name being repeated, such as -ol, -ate or -amide.

modes.description: A generic noun that completes a repeated drug or class name, such as acid, drug, capsule or syndrome.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are partial word pieces, which suggests it reduces the chance of continuing with another name piece once the repeated name is complete.
card.plain: It marks the point where a drug name already mentioned in the text is finished, so the name is not extended further.
